notes.title: UPDATE v1.1.0
notes.content: [p]What's new ?[/p][list][*][p]STEAM API support (the game pauses while the overlay is displayed).[/p][/*][*][p]The number of enemies has been reduced in "Easy" and "Very Easy" modes (most enemies that come from the left of the screen are no longer present).[/p][/*][*][p]Improved game colorimetry (more natural colors).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a non-exclusive full-screen mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the intensity of screen shake.[/p][/*][*][p]Music tracks that consist of an intro and a loop now flow seamlessly.[/p][/*][*][p]The game automatically pauses when a controller is disconnected (if playing with a controller).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text display issues that could display "?" instead of spaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Global sound volume defaulted to 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the IRVING HEAT logo (music tracks).[/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimizations.[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor fixes.[/p][/*][/list]
